## What this case checks

Confirm GeoCase preserves a scaled int16 NDVI product, its scale factor, and its NoData sentinel.

## Risk types covered

- [`dtype_drift`](../risk/dtype-drift.md)
- [`nodata_ignored`](../risk/nodata-ignored.md)
- `scale_factor_ignored`
